root_cause.text: The `nf_conncount` subsystem unconditionally skipped garbage collection (GC) in `__nf_conncount_add()` if a GC had already occurred within the same jiffy, which, combined with a low cleanup limit of 8 nodes, prevented stale connections from being evicted fast enough during high connection rates.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `__nf_conncount_add()` to only skip GC if the number of connections added since the last GC is below the new limit (`CONNCOUNT_GC_MAX_COLLECT`), changing the check from `if ((u32)jiffies == list->last_gc)` to `if ((u32)jiffies == list->last_gc && (list->count - list->last_gc_count) < CONNCOUNT_GC_MAX_COLLECT)`. Additionally, the commit message states: "If more than 8 new connections are tracked per jiffy the list won't be cleaned up fast enough possibly reaching the limit wrongly."
